This section will serve as the stable catalogue of research programmes and paper-oriented projects. Each project record will link to its canonical GitHub repository, scientific outputs, reproducible workflow, and status.

## Current priorities

- Multidimensional state of the north-central Peruvian anchovy stock.
- Anchovy selectivity and demographic change.
- Spatio-temporal and habitat modelling for pelagic resources.
- Peruvian tuna purse-seine fishery.
- Reproducible marine environmental data systems.

During the migration, existing Jekyll project records remain preserved and will be transferred here one by one without duplicating the underlying project repositories.
